test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 49

questions.question: A person borrows ₹44,800 at 25% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹2,000 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?
The average of 7 numbers is 49. If each number is decreased by 3, what will the new average be?

A and B can do a job together in 18 days. A is twice as efficient as B. If A works alone for 6 days and then both A and B work together to complete the remaining work, how long will it take to finish the job?
A shopkeeper marks an article at ₹x and offers a discount of 36% on it. He sells it for ₹456 after charging VAT of 25% on the discounted price. What is the value of x?
Rishi travels 468 km at 52 km/hr, the next 623 km at 89 km/hr and the next 290 km at 58 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey?(Correct to two decimal places)

His expenditure breakdown is as follows: (x + 7.5)% on food, (x + 2)% on entertainment, (x + 5.5)% on rent and the remaining on children’s education. If he spends ₹4,000 on children’s education, find the value of x.859
